categories.main_business_segments: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group primarily operates in the integrated computing power center sector, focusing on IDC (Internet Data Center) and AIDC (Artificial Intelligence Data Center) businesses. The company invests in, constructs, owns, and operates high-grade, efficient, and green computing power centers across multiple regions in China, providing hosting, management, and intelligent computing services to internet, cloud, and AI customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-density liquid cooling for servers, AI-driven intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, and green energy solutions to enhance energy efficiency and computing power. It employs a self-invested, self-built, self-owned, and self-operated model to ensure high reliability and performance, with proprietary software platforms for real-time monitoring and management of computing resources.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading internet companies, cloud service providers, AI enterprises, and certain government ministries. The company serves industries requiring large-scale, high-performance computing infrastructure, such as AI training and inference, cloud computing, and digital economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has established computing power infrastructure clusters in six major regions across China: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (Langfang), Yangtze River Delta (Pinghu), Greater Bay Area (Foshan and Huizhou), Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, Northwest China (Lanzhou), and Hainan Free Trade Port (Danzhou).
categories.supply_chain_position: Range Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the computing power supply chain, focusing on the investment, construction, ownership, and operation of data centers and intelligent computing centers, providing hosting and computing services directly to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in liquid cooling technology, green and low-carbon data center development, AI-driven intelligent operation and maintenance, and full-stack AI computing ecosystems. It actively invests in R&D projects related to energy efficiency, AI-enabled monitoring, and smart management platforms to lead the transition towards high-density, green, and intelligent computing infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of IDC and AIDC services, including hosting, management, and computing power provision. The company operates mainly on a wholesale model in collaboration with telecom operators, charging customers based on the number of deployed cabinets and service agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Range Technology is positioned as a leading player in China's integrated computing power center industry, recognized for its nationwide strategic layout, advanced liquid cooling technology, and comprehensive AI computing services. It competes with other data center operators and AI infrastructure providers, leveraging its scale, resource control, and technological innovation to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.36 billion, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.79 billion, showing modest growth over the previous year. Total assets reached over RMB 31 billion, reflecting a 34% increase year-over-year, supported by significant investments in new computing centers and infrastructure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Range Technology differentiates itself through its early and strategic acquisition of scarce land, energy, and power resources near major Chinese cities, its pioneering adoption of high-density liquid cooling technology, and its comprehensive self-operated model ensuring stable, secure, reliable, and green computing services. The company’s full-stack AI computing ecosystem and strong client trust built over 16 years create a robust competitive moat.
